scientific_integrity: The novel candidate is the all-finite-horizon convex-order comparison and strict second-year risk law. Model, rank-one mixing condition, and elementary Jensen symmetrization are acknowledged prior/general mathematics; independent scientific validation is absent.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to two linear habitats with exchangeable positive growth shocks and independent environmental years. Risk compares each strategy after normalization by its own mean; neither absolute population survival nor long-run log-growth is optimized. Second-moment formulas require finite second moments. Historical-priority assessment remains provisional.
title: Universal finite-horizon convex-risk minimum for two dispersing habitats
